title: Tests: attachment upload/download integration round-trip
description:
What: Integration test covering the full attachment lifecycle: upload blob, create message with attachment, deliver to peer, peer retrieves attachment metadata.

Algorithm:
1. Use existing two-instance harness (from kith-3f2 integration testing epic).
2. Test scenario:
   a. Owner A uploads known blob (32 bytes of known content) via POST /jmap/upload.
   b. Verify response: blobId non-empty, size=32, sha256 matches sha256(known_content).
   c. Owner A creates message with attachment (Message/set create, chatId for A↔B, attachments=[{blobId, filename, contentType, size, sha256}]).
   d. Wait for outbox delivery to B (poll or trigger tick).
   e. Owner B calls Message/get — verify message has attachments array with blobId, filename, contentType matching what A sent.
   f. Owner A downloads via GET /jmap/download — verify bytes match original content bit-exactly.
3. Oracle: sha256(known_content) computed independently, hardcoded in test as hex literal.

Defensive rules: use known test content (not random) for deterministic oracle comparison; verify sha256 bit-exactly.

Agent team: R reads existing two-instance harness setup; T writes test; V runs cargo test -p kithd --features test-utils + clippy.
